description.value: Crust n Crunch is a BC-based pizza and donair chain with over 11 years in the industry, known for bold flavour combinations including South Asian-inspired options like Shahi Paneer and Butter Chicken pizzas alongside classic donairs. The brand emphasizes halal-certified ingredients and caters to schools, businesses, and events. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a fast, filling meal with strong vegetarian options and online ordering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Crust n Crunch is a Lower Mainland pizza-and-donair chain with extensive vegetarian menu options (Greek Delight, Pesto Garden, Veggie Trio, Shahi Paneer Delight, Spinach Feta Delight, Tandoori Paneer) and clear takeout/online ordering capability. However, the website lists only three current locations (New Westminster, SFU Burnaby Campus, Delta/Scott Rd) and makes no mention of a North Vancouver location at 938 Twelfth Street, which is a significant discrepancy warranting review. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging appears on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: North Vancouver location at 938 Twelfth Street is not listed on the official crustncrunch.com locations page, which lists only New Westminster, SFU Burnaby Campus, and Delta (Scott Rd). This location may have closed or may be a phantom/stale OSM entry.
No phone number in OSM or on website for this specific location.
Address is not corroborated by website content.
